title: $\tau$-Elicitation: Benchmarking multi-turn entity extraction in voice agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice agents often need to collect names, addresses, identifiers, dates, and times exactly, yet end-to-end benchmarks obscure where capture fails. We introduce $\tau$-Elicitation, a 200-task voice benchmark spanning 10 entity types, controlled difficulty, caller realisms, and three environments. A matched text agent passes all tasks, but four voice configurations achieve robust exact success from 0.14 to 0.41. Agents increase verification for hard and unfamiliar entities and sometimes for incorrect captures, but not for their weakest caller voice; only 24 to 37 percent of verified errors are repaired. A scaffold that prescribes spelling, read-back, correction, and confirmation raises robust Pass$^3$ by 14 to 31 points, at a cost of 21 to 28 seconds per call. translated_title: τ-启发：语音智能体中多轮实体提取的基准测试
translated_abstract: 语音智能体经常需要精确地收集姓名、地址、标识符、日期和时间等信息，然而端到端的基准测试掩盖了信息捕获失败的具体环节。我们提出了 τ-Elicitation，这是一个包含 200 个任务的语音基准测试，涵盖 10 种实体类型、受控难度、来电者真实情境以及三种环境。一个匹配的文本智能体可以通过所有任务，但四种语音配置实现的稳健精确成功率仅为 0.14 到 0.41。智能体会对困难和陌生的实体增加验证，有时也会对错误的捕获增加验证，但对其最弱的来电者语音却不会增加验证；经验证的错误中仅有 24% 到 37% 被修复。一个规定了拼写、复述、纠正和确认的框架（scaffold）将稳健的 Pass³ 提高了 14 到 31 个百分点，代价是每次通话增加 21 到 28 秒。诸如拼写变体和重新开始等真实情境对精确成功率没有可检测到的影响；而发音错误会增加修复的工作量。这些结果识别了策略选择和成功……
tldr: 提出 τ-Elicitation 语音基准测试，揭示语音智能体在精确实体提取上表现远逊于文本智能体（精确成功率仅0.14-0.41），并证明结构化验证框架可提升成功率14-31个百分点。
en_tdlr: Introduces τ-Elicitation, a 200-task voice benchmark revealing that voice agents achieve only 0.14-0.41 robust exact success in entity extraction despite a matched text agent passing all tasks, and shows that a structured verification scaffold improves success by 14-31 points.
